answer: The wander holds work receipts rather than names, so the meadow of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the thread of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, unlocked only after continuous uptime, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
